subject: Superseding claim: Gen5 Lane F virtual-hinge telemetry/debugging
body: Supersedes my Lane D claim after Manager dedupe. Claiming currently-unowned Lane F against main bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea. Scope: implementation-grade debug schema/replay contract for physical-vs-virtual angle, prediction confidence/correction/fallback, requested/effective frame cadence, split-pane ownership/readiness, presentation fences, lifecycle/reversal/crash recovery, and export completeness. Goal is to make Gen5 field failures reconstructable frame-by-frame without changing runtime authority or closing behavior. No production Git writes.
